description: Implement Verified Post-Journey Ratings and Reviews system. Create Review model with verification checks (user must have completed booking for route), REST endpoints for CRUD operations with authorization, review display on bus/route details pages, star rating UI, helpful vote system, edit within 24h restriction, and review moderation. No existing review code exists - build from scratch.
steps: 1. Create Review model at frontend/server/models/review.js with schema: { userId: String (indexed), userName: String, routeId: ObjectId (ref Route, indexed), busId: ObjectId (ref Bus, optional, indexed), bookingId: ObjectId (ref Booking, required for verification), rating: Number (1-5, required), comment: String (min 20 chars, required), helpful: [String] (userIds who voted helpful), reportedBy: [String], hidden: Boolean (default false), verified: Boolean (default false), createdAt: Date, updatedAt: Date }. Index: { routeId: 1, createdAt: -1 }, { busId: 1, createdAt: -1 }

2. Add verification logic: before allowing review creation, query Booking model for bookingId with customerId matching userId. Verify booking.status === 'completed' and booking.journeyDate < today. Set verified: true if checks pass, false otherwise

3. Create review controller at frontend/server/controller/review.js with methods: createReview(userId, routeId, busId, bookingId, rating, comment), updateReview(reviewId, userId, rating, comment) - only if review.createdAt > Date.now() - 24*3600*1000 and review.userId === userId, deleteReview(reviewId, userId) - only if review.userId === userId, getReviews(routeId, busId, page, limit), voteHelpful(reviewId, userId), reportReview(reviewId, userId), moderateReview(reviewId, action) - admin only, returns average rating

4. Create review routes at frontend/server/routes/review.js: POST /api/v1/reviews (auth required), PUT /api/v1/reviews/:id (author only, 24h check), DELETE /api/v1/reviews/:id (author only), GET /api/v1/reviews?routeId=X&busId=Y&page=1, POST /api/v1/reviews/:id/helpful, POST /api/v1/reviews/:id/report, GET /api/v1/reviews/average?routeId=X&busId=Y, POST /api/v1/reviews/:id/moderate (admin only)
5. Register review routes in frontend/server/index.js: const reviewRoutes = require('./routes/review'); app.use(reviewRoutes);

6. Add authorization checks: extract userId from req.headers['x-user-id'], verify userId matches review.userId for update/delete. For moderate endpoint, check if user.role === 'admin' (add role field to User model if needed, default 'user')

7. Create frontend service at frontend/src/app/service/review.service.ts with methods: createReview(payload), updateReview(reviewId, payload), deleteReview(reviewId), getReviews(routeId, busId, page), voteHelpful(reviewId), reportReview(reviewId), getAverageRating(routeId, busId)

8. Create star rating component at frontend/src/app/Component/common/star-rating/star-rating.component.ts: displays 1-5 stars, supports input mode (clickable) and display mode (read-only), emits ratingChange event. Use mat-icon with star/star_border icons

9. Create review form component at frontend/src/app/Component/reviews/review-form/review-form.component.ts with: star rating input (1-5, required), comment textarea (min 20 chars, required), bookingId input (user selects from their completed bookings for this route), submit button. Validate comment length >= 20 chars

10. Create review list component at frontend/src/app/Component/reviews/review-list/review-list.component.ts: displays reviews with userName, verified badge (if verified), star rating, comment, helpful count, helpful button, report button, edit button (if currentUser === review.userId and within 24h), delete button (if currentUser === review.userId). Show 'Trusted Reviewer' badge if verified. Pagination controls

11. Add review section to bus/route details pages: If selectbus-page component shows bus details, add review list below bus info showing reviews for that routeId and busId. Display average rating at top. Show review form button (opens modal or expands form) only for authenticated users with completed bookings

12. Add translation keys to en.json, hi.json, mr.json: REVIEWS.TITLE, REVIEWS.WRITE_REVIEW, REVIEWS.YOUR_RATING, REVIEWS.COMMENT, REVIEWS.SUBMIT, REVIEWS.UPVOTE, REVIEWS.TRUSTED_REVIEWER, REVIEWS.EDIT, REVIEWS.DELETE, REVIEWS.EDIT_LOCKED, REVIEWS.AVERAGE_RATING, REVIEWS.NO_REVIEWS, REVIEWS.MIN_CHARS, REVIEWS.SELECT_BOOKING, REVIEWS.VERIFIED_TRAVELER
13. Handle edit restriction: when review.createdAt + 24h < now, disable edit button and show tooltip 'Editing locked after 24 hours' using REVIEWS.EDIT_LOCKED key
14. Auto-hide reviews when reportedBy.length >= 5 (similar to Post model): add pre-save hook in Review model
acceptance_criteria: Review model exists with all specified fields, indexes, and verification logic
Users can create reviews only for routes/buses they have completed bookings for
Review verification field is set to true if booking is completed and journey date is past
Review form requires 1-5 star rating and comment with minimum 20 characters
Review list displays on bus/route details page with average rating at top
Users can edit their own reviews within 24 hours of creation
Users can delete their own reviews at any time
Edit button is disabled after 24 hours with appropriate tooltip
Helpful voting works - users can vote once, count increments
Report functionality works - review auto-hides when reportedBy reaches 5
Verified badge displays for reviews from verified travelers (completed bookings)
All review UI text uses REVIEWS.* translation keys
Non-authors cannot edit or delete others' reviews (403 response from backend)

Click edit within 24h, verify edit works. Use MongoDB to set createdAt to 2 days ago, reload page, verify edit button is disabled with tooltip
Sign in as different user, verify edit and delete buttons do not appear on first user's review
Click helpful button, verify count increments to 1
Verify GET /api/v1/reviews/average returns correct average rating for route
